meta.title: Routine Planner, Habit Tracker
meta.summary: Daily Habit Tracker for Focus & ADHD — structured planner, reminder, to do list
meta.description:
⚡ Switch on your action — with Routinery
An all-in-one habit tracker, planner, and reminder that helps you follow your routine with timers and reminders — no willpower needed.

You know what to do — but getting started is the hardest part.
Routinery combines a habit tracker, structured planner, and timer system to help you take action and stay consistent, without overthinking what to do next.

🧠 Why it works for ADHD & focus

If you have ADHD — or simply struggle with focus, time, or consistency — the challenge isn’t knowing what to do, but actually starting and staying on track.

Routinery is designed around those challenges.

• Hard to start → the timer gives you a clear starting point  
• Time feels unclear → each step runs with a timer so you can feel time passing  
• Focus drops quickly → short routines like focus pomodoro keep you engaged  
• Too many tasks feel overwhelming → small steps make it easier to take action  

With a habit tracker, structured planner, and reminders, you don’t rely on motivation — you follow a system.

This is not just for ADHD — it’s for anyone who struggles to follow through.

👉 You plan but never start
